name: Bonee
quote: Inside this small body lies a will of steel.

voices.label: Good Morning
voices.text: Good morning... Professor!

voices.label: Good Afternoon
voices.text: S-sorry! I accidentally knocked over one of the lab's skeletal specimens!

voices.label: Good Evening
voices.text: I want a break.

voices.label: Good Night
voices.text: Phew... I'm going to fall asleep...

voices.label: Main Interface Voice 1
voices.text: Osteosynthesis technology is really advanced nowadays! You won't feel any pain at all... And, and you can even choose what kind of material you want your new bone to be made of!

voices.label: Main Interface Voice 2
voices.text: Ah... the test results are in! Hmmm... Professor, you need more physical exercise.

voices.label: Main Interface Voice 3
voices.text: H-Hey... Professor, what's going on? Wake up!

voices.label: Home Screen 5
voices.text: We're going to conduct a physical examination today. Are you going to come along?

voices.label: Interactive Voice 1
voices.text: Whoa!

voices.label: Interactive Voice 2
voices.text: That tickles...

voices.label: Interactive Voice 3
voices.text: What's the matter, Professor?

voices.label: On Duty
voices.text: Y-yes!

voices.label: Obtain
voices.text: N-nice to see you again, Professor! Do you remember my name? It's Bonee!

voices.label: Potential Breakthrough
voices.text: Hopefully I've made some progress...

voices.label: Neural Expansion
voices.text: I did it! But... I still don't feel any confidence...

voices.label: Max Rank
voices.text: With courage and the right technique, there's nothing you can't accomplish... L-like that?

voices.label: Join Team
voices.text: U-understood!

voices.label: Battle Start
voices.text: Are we going to fight them like this...?

voices.label: Ultimate Skill
voices.text: H-help! Help meeee!

voices.label: MVP 1
voices.text: No way... I actually did it!

voices.label: MVP 2
voices.text: Phew... that's a relief.

voices.label: Defeat
voices.text: I'm sorry... Professor...

voices.label: Oath
voices.text: W-Why would you choose me as your oath partner, Professor? What do you possibly see in me? What part of me do you like that much? Well, I  suppose we'll figure it out!

voices.label: New Year
voices.text: H-Happy... Happy New Year, Professor!

voices.label: Valentine's Day
voices.text: T-This, this is some lemon-flavored white chocolate I made for you. It's in the shape of a bone. I hope you like it...

voices.label: Tanabata
voices.text: There're so many people crowding over here, I-I feel like I'm going to suffocate... Ah! It's a shooting star!

voices.label: Halloween
voices.text: Professor, are you afraid of ghosts? Eeek! I just saw something staring at us in the dark... What? Oh, it was just a skeletal specimen...

voices.label: Christmas
voices.text: Museums usually stay open during Christmas. Oh, speaking of which, I've not seen a complete Triassic fossil yet...

voices.label: Birthday Wish
voices.text: Is... Is it your birthday today, Professor? Oh no, what should I do? I haven't prepared anything! I'm s-so sorry! I'll be sure to prepare something for you next time!

voices.label: Neural Cloud
voices.text: Neural Cloud

voices.label: Intimacy 1
voices.text: I-I can't help you in battle, but I want to do the best I can! I can't just sit back and watch, while everyone else is out there giving it their all!

voices.label: Intimacy 2
voices.text:
Erm, hey... Eeeek!!?
A-am I going to be at the front?
T-the enemies are coming right at me... Aaaaahhh! Help meeeee!!!

voices.label: Intimacy 3
voices.text:
"You did well. Everyone's safe because of your hard work."
That's the first time someone has ever praised me like that. I didn't really contribute that much, but still... It made me happy.

voices.label: Intimacy 4
voices.text:
What should I do now?
I want to do something to protect everyone, no matter how insignificant my role may be.

voices.label: Intimacy 5
voices.text: Once I get back to the real world... The first thing I'm going to do is visit all the fossil museums around the globe! Professor... I'll invite you to join me, too!

career:
UL-OS is a medical series doll manufactured by Ultimate Life intended to change the negative way people tend to view medical dolls. To this end, all dolls in this series feature an impeccably crafted exterior designed to induce a sympathetic reaction. It was only after Bonee, the first prototype, was put into production and activated that Ultimate Life realized the fatal flaw in their design: Bonee was far too petite, so much so that all the mass-produced operating tables were too tall for her.

Even though UL-OS went through many different design iterations after this, Bonee remained. Not only that, but she received glowing reviews upon being placed in a hospital, and was even considered a shining example of what a doll placed in the medical profession was capable of. It's for this reason that she was chosen to be part of Project Neural Cloud.
infoStories:
Were it not for her work uniform, most people would find it hard to believe that this girl, despite her youthful appearance and bashfulness, is in fact a highly experienced medical professional.

Bonee's appearance has led to many people underestimating her. No matter how often she proves herself with her incredible technique, few people can believe their eyes when they see what appears to be a little girl acting as the operating surgeon. This lack of faith in her only increases when they are the ones laying on the operating table.

As a result, the hospital arranged for a compensation program soon after Bonee began working there in order to assuage patients that she was dependable.

Besides the patients, many of Bonee's medical colleagues also have misgivings about her. While they do not doubt a medical doll's ability to successfully carry out surgery, they are more concerned with Bonee's high-strung personality and whether it will affect her ability to operate.

However, by letting her actions speak for her, Bonee has quelled all doubts surrounding her. Despite the fact that she is a nervous wreck in her everyday life and even while preparing for surgery, Bonee becomes a completely different person the moment she enters the operating room, where her technique is unmatched, and her judgment decisive.

The moment she is done with surgery, Bonee once again becomes a weak-willed and bashful little girl. Most unexpected of all is that this has garnered the attention of the older doctors. After meeting Bonee, many doctors who have retired or seldom operate anymore change their tune and wish to treat her like a granddaughter, or take her on as an apprentice.

Hospitals are breeding grounds for bizarre and far-fetched tall tales. These stories spread like wildfire to liven up the humdrum of hospital life, becoming more and more exaggerated with each retelling. Bonee had just started working at the hospital when she heard the tale of Mace Girl from one of her coworkers.

Most ghost stories are painted with the same broad strokes, and this one was no different: a little girl dying a wrongful death and becoming a vengeful spirit. However, Bonee was beside herself upon hearing it. This was because the spirit of a girl, who wielded a ghastly mace, was said to haunt the very offices that she worked in.

In the days that followed, Bonee was panic-stricken, begging her co-workers not to leave her alone the instant the sun went down. This continued until one day, when the origin of the legend was uncovered.

In a grainy screen capture of some surveillance footage, Bonee could be seen carrying a human calf bone while running down the hallway.

Of all the departments in the hospital, Bonee is the biggest hit in pediatrics. Her affable nature makes even the rowdiest little hellions quiet down once they see her and cling onto her every word. She has such a way with children that many of the parents will ask her for advice on how to get their children to be more obedient.

If Bonee's arrival in the pediatrics department is a blessing, then it is an unmitigated disaster whenever she leaves. When this happens, doctors and patients are treated to the sight of throngs of children gathering around Bonee, begging for her to stay. Despite her timid nature, Bonee summons her courage and comforts them in these moments. Only when she promises them that she will be back as soon as she can she then extricate herself from the situation.

Persicaria once had a private conversation with Bonee, before she arrived at the Oasis and its medical department. Within her files, there was a seemingly inconspicuous evaluation record that nevertheless to the doctor was of critical importance—she was capable of great empathy.

No matter how loftily the medical profession is portrayed in fictions, in the end it is a job where one often comes into close contact with blood and gore, and people's lives are left in your hands. For many doctors, remaining calm and even apathetic in the face of pain and suffering is something they do not wish to do, but must.

Persicaria was concerned if Bonee was up to the task. In the wake of the Wipe-off Incident, Magrasea resembled a battlefield more than anything. Could all of Bonee's accomplishments simply be a result of her being given a cushy job at her previous hospital? Until she got an answer to this question, Persicaria would not be able to dispel her concerns about placing Bonee in the Oasis medical department.

Although the exact content of their conversation is unknown, one thing is certain: Bonee reported to the Oasis medical department the very next day.
oathDesc: Become a sturdy shield for that petite girl.

projections.name: Little Orthopaedic Surgeon
projections.desc:
Attire produced with Neural Cloud Projection upon a Doll's arrival in Magrasea. These are the clothes they are most comfortable in.
"The human body is so much more complex than that of a Doll's. What's even more amazing is how the number of bones in human body actually changes with age."

projections.name: Little Bone Carver
projections.desc:
Attire and environment produced with Neural Cloud Projection upon a Doll's arrival in Magrasea, which mirrors their life in the real world.
"Medicine and art are not necessarily different fields of study. Da Vinci would have agreed with this statement."

skinList.name: Lavender Message
skinList.desc:
[Call of Study Series]
A delicate skeleton model shines as it is constructed from tiny parts by Bonee's nimble hands. The summer breeze blows into the activity room, adding a refreshing touch to the freshly built model.

skinList.name: Wishing Projection
skinList.desc:
Warming fireworks fill the silent night, and as the embers fall, they transform into countless candleflames. This is the most beautiful scene that the Dolls left behind on a Qixi summer night.
"Please take this. Think of it as a knight... ah, I mean, as a doctor receiving a return gift from a well-behaved patient. I hope you like it."
